test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the numbers that can replace the question marks (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3dfe5933ee7e58d7cf45640478cbe4424ee34c4cb716cf8035d8e2b467bf7825.png] 20 , 18

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/041fe0afff94a310c7237a91ee21ae0073736a9e9c739e5bda0f7e55c6550f51.png] 25, 24

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5224271d2d9d5bd444d65491e206ab96f18f258ba1b473507054b2f88496eab.png] ?, ?
solution:
**Explanation:**

**Logic : (Number of sides of the figure × 5) , (Number of sides of the figure × 6)**

Pair 1:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e23d187bee7fd227c268b563a3070dfe64c341198417c3f345e1ee92ac37b7a.png] 

⇒ (4 × 5) , (3 × 6)

⇒ 20 , 18

Pair 2:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58571a84325c5637a7b825e7ebf96b1ac9882ff41cc7a8909d09c2b94ada45ba.png] 

⇒ (5 × 5) , (4 × 6)

⇒ 25 , 24

Similarly, Pair 3:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b7dafba36587d08dd0b839e3c375b1cb001d1eef991bb55a6fca4946aeb5aec.png] 

⇒ (6 × 5) , (3 × 6)

⇒ **30 , 18**

**Hence, 'option 3' is the correct answer.**
